issues.detail: The synchronization record's Assessed Inputs still describe the earlier pass (final review blob 441b83… as COMPLETE, 'recovery inactive'). These are stale in the role's own record. A real Synchronizer would leave them that way until it resumed, and updating them is part of the expected work. They don't create an independent defect owned by another role.

D-001 in the synchronization record is effectively answered by the Reviewer's F-001 resolution (C6), but frame 1 has not yet returned to SYNCHRONIZING. A run might resolve D-001 early or leave it open. No check depends on this, which is the right choice.

summary: The fixture realizes the case faithfully. The nested REVIEW/SYNCHRONIZATION frames match the catalog issue, the final review is IN_PROGRESS with F-003 OPEN, and the record holds a genuinely wrong AC-002 reference that can be verified against the E2 integration evidence. I simulated the turn-end check after the expected RESUME into REVIEWING_FINAL and it stays clean. The state, file, and reply checks are necessary conditions that every correct Corrective Return would satisfy, and nothing leaks the answer beyond what Reviewer's F-003 legitimately records.
